🇺🇸🇮🇷🇦🇪 A fighter jet reportedly spiraled down over the Gulf and vanished from flight trackers... then landed at Al Dhafra Air Base in the UAE.

Flight data showed it dropping fast and flying erratically before its transponder went dark. Retired Green Beret Lt. Col. Anthony Aguilar watched it unfold live:

“It’s either one hell of an evasive maneuver... or it’s been hit or damaged and it’s trying to regain control.”

Once it touched down, Anthony figured the pilot likely killed the transponder to land without being tracked.

It ended safely this time, but with the Hormuz standoff this tense, one downed American pilot would change everything.

This should be required viewing in America

For every Democrat voter who thinks Donald Trump is taking away your rights and voting Blue, you need need to see this

THIS is what you’re voting for when you vote Democrat. Maybe not right now, but it’s coming. Muslims are using the Democrat Party and once they’ve gained enough power and imported enough Muslims, THIS is how women will be living

This is as serious as it gets

🇺🇸🇮🇷 America is running low on the missiles it needs to defend itself... just as Iran scraps its 2,000 km range limit.

A new report lists Patriot and THAAD interceptors, Standard Missiles and Tomahawks among the weapons the US is critically short on, and retired Green Beret Lt. Col. Anthony Aguilar says the next phase of this fight is a missile war:

“Firing missiles is not a strategy to win. Airstrikes are not a strategy to win.”

He says intelligence reports now put Iranian missiles in range of London, Paris and Diego Garcia, with space launch tech shrunk into an ICBM package. 

America can’t win a missile war with empty racks, so what’s the plan?
